svg.title: It is well defined because adding any multiple of (1, −1/4, 1) changes neither coordinate. TR45 proves that these maps are inverse. Transporting the detector target therefore recovers the same free two-column inverse, not just its rank. Equip the horizontal finite spaces with the transported norms. The bare coordinates can be retained unchanged, with sZ i = Jdetsi, pZ i = Jdetpi and lZ i = liQdet. Their composition obeys lZ i sZ i = lisi, and all TR46 remainder norms agree. Write M = supi ∥li∥and εi = ∥ti(lisi−L)∥→0. The three-term correction error then has the explicit bound
